content.text:
I've submitted index 19 (Cr 0.33, Sb 0.67) as the best composition. The episode is finished and all 3 EQE measurements are used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.26 | −0.0024 |
| 13 | 0.49 | 0.0045 |
| **19** | **0.67** | **0.0153** |

- **Trend:** EQE went up as Sb content increased. The Cr-rich sample gave a negative reading.
- **Phase:** index 19 is close to the CrSb₂O₆ ratio (the trirutile structure). I didn't use any XRD measurements, so I haven't confirmed which phase is actually in the film.
- **What's untested:** 3 points can't show where EQE peaks on this composition line. The more Sb-rich samples (indices 20–27) were never measured, so the true best may lie beyond index 19 and I can't rule that out.
